The problem


## More properties. More owner statements. More problems.


Perhaps you've experienced this before. It's time to send your owners their statements at the end of the month, and you're stuck in spreadsheet hell when you'd rather be focused on growing your business.


First, you pull data from Guesty and Airbnb. But that's when the problems start. You've got payouts showing in your OTAs with no matching cash in the bank, and dozens of bookings with mismatched data across systems. The paperwork circus begins: your first bookkeeper compiles the data, a second one checks it, and then you're stuck doing final reviews to make sure everything looks clean before it goes to your owners.


Weeks pass just on this instead of growing your business.


Of course the problem only gets worse as your business grows. Every new door is another line to check, another 100 rows in your spreadsheets, and more manual time spent confirming discrepancies before your statements go out.


Whether or not you're officially doing trust accounting, you're responsible for making sure money is tracked and allocated correctly between your business and every owner whose property you manage. It's critical to get it right.


**Up to two weeks.** **Multiple people.** **Every single month.**


That's what our clients told us owner statements were costing them.


The Blaze solution


## Blaze turns owner statement hell into a breeze.


We built the team you wish you had into a single AI CFO. It pulls every booking, payout and expense together, drafts every owner's statement, and brings you only the handful of lines that need your judgment, with the receipts attached. You approve. Your owners get statements they can trust. And you finally get to spend the first of the month on what actually moves your business: adding more doors.
